summary: The team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives, with the China Going Global report and SEO-driven program promotion leading the charge, while website redesign and social media agency selection move forward in parallel.
summaryDetail: The most critical focus is the China Going Global report, co-published with IE, targeting a September launch at Singapore events. This week, Joseph and Tian Xuefang are reviewing the compiled document, and the team is finalizing contributions, translations, and launch logistics, including potential collaborations with Tech In Asia and EuroCham. Simultaneously, SEO and program promotion for Asia Star and Intelligent China are ramping up, with Joseph drafting target areas and the team analyzing audience profiles and conversion tracking. The knowledge website redesign is in feedback phase, with decisions to remove videos and integrate indices, while the social media agency selection has been resolved by prioritizing Media Minds. Urgent housekeeping includes resolving the Outlook account lockout and ensuring all action items, such as the AI meta-description review and chatbot testing, stay on track for end-of-July deadlines.
